## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (for changes to the page)
- [ ] New or changed config options have a friendly error test, docs in `docs/CONFIG.md`, and an updated `folio.schema.json` (`npm run schema`)
- [ ] No new JavaScript on the published page (or it's behind an option that's off by default)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased" if users would notice
